title: The Real Way to Land an AI Job
description:
What's the real way to prove AI skills and land the job? It's not a certification by itself, anyone who says that is just selling you one. What a cert actually does is get you past filters: recruiters and applicant tracking systems scan for signals, and a recognized certification survives the six-second resume scan.

It also forces structure onto your learning. But the combination that actually works is one good certification plus at least one strong project you can demo. 

The cert gets you seen, the project proves you can do it.

#techwithtim #aiengineer #techjobs

top_comments.text: Can you suggest any certifications for AI/ SYSTEM DESIGN/ AGENTS etc

top_reply.author: @MaxGuides
top_reply.text: AWS AI Certs are still great because of how few of them there are & the good naming compared to microsoft certs.  You can stack GCP & Azure or AI certs on top since AWS has those now.  Easiest way to get into Google outside of internships is AWS + GCP certs... again they won't really say they care about them but what it signals is someone who will start producing value quickly as they are already familiar with the environment.
